name: Grief ~Nemurenu Omoi Tsutaetakute~
original_name: Grief ～眠れぬ想い伝えたくて～
source:
A girl is happy to finally able to go to the school of the guy she loves. She moved into school dorm and met her room mate. Next day, she bump into our guy in her hurry to school. Thus they meet, and our guy can chase her, his classmate/swim team girl or the swim team female captain. The first girl is easy to get and he can even share her if he really want to, thus enabling him to go after her room mate. You get to see some of the first girl's events, which show how much she love our guy.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161210003249/http://www.members.shaw.ca/lisun/jhag-wng.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
translation:
一个女孩终于可以去上自己喜欢的男孩所在的学校，她为此感到十分幸福。她搬进学校宿舍，并遇到了室友。第二天，她匆忙赶去学校时撞上了男主角。

就这样，他们相遇了。男主角可以追求她、她的同班同学兼游泳队成员，或游泳队的女队长。第一个女孩很容易攻略；如果他真的愿意，甚至可以和别人共享她，这样就能进一步追求她的室友。

你可以看到第一个女孩的一些剧情，从中了解她有多么喜欢男主角。

[来自 [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161210003249/http://www.members.shaw.ca/lisun/jhag-wng.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
